description_one_sentence: The list of everyone who has an account at ShopFast, with their contact details and whether they agreed to receive marketing emails.
issues_spotted: Uniqueness: 8 customer_id appear twice (1241 rows for 1233 distinct customers) | Consistency: country is written 17 different ways for 4 countries (FR, fr, France, france, FRA...) and 37 are empty | Validity: birth_date and signup_date use 4 different formats (2021/10/20, 14/07/2024, 04-10-2025, 09-04-1986) and are stored as text | Validity: 28 emails are invalid (9 with a leading space, 9 cut after the @ like patricia.gimenez@, 5 with a double @ like cristina.campoy@@outlook.com, 5 otherwise malformed like gilbert.schmitt@orange) | Completeness: 48 missing emails (4%), 30 missing phones

description_one_sentence: The catalogue of everything ShopFast sells, with names, categories and prices.
issues_spotted: Uniqueness: sku SF-FAS-0522 is used by two products, Wireless Earbuds (501) and Running Shoes (522) | Accuracy: Hand Cream (533) has a negative price of -22.19 | Completeness: Mechanical Keyboard (506) has no unit_price_eur | Consistency: 7 products have a category with a trailing space or wrong case (Electronics , electronics, Fashion , Beauty , SPORTS)

description_one_sentence: One line for every purchase made by a customer, with its date and its status.
issues_spotted: Uniqueness: 7 fully duplicated rows (5207 rows for 5200 distinct order_id) | Consistency: status has 9 spellings for 5 real values (cancelled/canceled, delivered/Delivered/delivered with a space, shipped/SHIPPED) | Completeness: 11 missing order_date

description_one_sentence: The detail of what was bought in each order: which products, how many and at what price.
issues_spotted: Integrity: 4 items point to product_id 999, which does not exist in the product catalogue | Validity: quantity and unit_price_eur stored as text, so no numeric range check is possible

description_one_sentence: The money received for each order, with the amount and the payment method.
issues_spotted: Consistency: card_last4 is filled for 517 of 805 bank transfers (should be empty) and missing for 1059 of 2539 card payments | Integrity: 1 shipped order has no payment (the 297 other orders without payment are pending) | Accuracy: 6 payments have an amount different from the order total

description_one_sentence: The requests and complaints that customers send to ShopFast's support team, with how they were handled.
issues_spotted: Privacy: 53 tickets contain a valid IBAN together with the account holder's name in the free-text message | Privacy: 73 messages contain an email address and 109 contain a phone number | Privacy: 62 agent_notes contain the customer's birth date | Completeness: agent_notes empty in 150 rows (36%) | Consistency: some subjects do not match the message (e.g. 'Great service, thank you!' filed under 'Damaged item', at least 11 cases)

description_one_sentence: The list of customers selected for a marketing campaign, with their email, first name and loyalty level.
issues_spotted: Privacy: emails and first names in clear text and no consent column, so consent can only be proven by joining to customers (all 600 are consented today) | Consistency: 29 exported emails differ from the email stored in customers (19 customers have no email in the source, 10 have a truncated, double-@ or malformed one) | Validity: 6 emails contain accented characters (victoire.lemaître@yahoo.fr, jerôme.coulon@web.de)
